item: Card quality loop: cards in the Field data download, a recurring self-check, and an offline report
key_paths: src/briefing/card_quality.py; src/api/diagnostics/field_cards.py; scripts/card_quality_report.py; src/briefing/service.py; src/briefing/registry.py; src/static/app-diagnostics.js; tests/test_card_quality.py
summary: The Field data button also saves oo-field-cards.zip (POST /api/diagnostics/field-cards): every Home card as cached with its dismissed state, the feed's record (stopped/kept/incomplete, each producer's time and outcome, which producer made each card, stale by corpus growth), per-card trigger math recomputed and the evidence articles (exact count, 25 shown with metadata, linked layers and a 600-char excerpt), the quality checks and the self-check history; every string scrubbed, addresses without user, query or fragment, newsletter bodies withheld (R655), and a manifest that counts the personal content it carries. After each Home refresh the app runs the cheap checks and keeps one line in card_quality_selfcheck.jsonl (newest 200, ids and counts only); nothing is shown on Home. scripts/card_quality_report.py (stdlib only, loads the same check module by path) ranks findings across accuracy, honesty, usefulness, performance and coverage and compares a round with the previous one. No score; an unchecked card is never a pass.
